name: clean
description: Clean Docker storage using controlled cleanup policies.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: cleanup
arguments.description: Cleanup strategy to run: tag, cache, unused or complete.

arguments.name: minimum_storage
arguments.description: Minimum free Docker storage in GB; cleanup is skipped while at least this much is available.

arguments.name: tag_pattern
arguments.description: Text matched against image references (repository:tag) to select images; required when cleanup is 'tag'.

arguments.name: force
arguments.description: Run the cleanup even when the minimum storage requirement is already met.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.description: Report what would be removed without removing anything.

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.description: Confirmation required to run the destructive 'complete' cleanup.

outputs.name: storage_before_gb
outputs.description: Available Docker storage in GB before cleanup.

outputs.name: storage_after_gb
outputs.description: Available Docker storage in GB after cleanup.

outputs.name: storage_reclaimed_gb
outputs.description: Storage reclaimed by the cleanup in GB.

outputs.name: cleanup_required
outputs.description: Always false when published; reserved flag for whether cleanup was needed.

outputs.name: items_removed
outputs.description: Number of images or resources removed.

outputs.name: matched_images
outputs.description: Image references matched by the tag pattern (tag cleanup only).

outputs.name: exit_code
outputs.description: Exit code of the last Docker command.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the last Docker command succeeded.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: Standard output of the last Docker command.

outputs.name: stderr
outputs.description: Standard error of the last Docker command.

outputs.name: duration
outputs.description: Duration of the last Docker command in seconds.
